title: EEG-FM-Audit: A Systematic Evaluation and Analysis Pipeline for EEG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.26910v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) show potential for learning generalized representations from heterogeneous EEG signals. However, existing studies exhibit three critical limitations: opaque model tuning, unverified contributions of complex learning paradigms to EEG-FMs, and a limited understanding of the neurophysiological features that FMs rely on to make decisions. To address these challenges, we propose EEG-FM-Audit, a systematic evaluation and diagnostic pipeline comprising three modules: (1) a fairness-calibrated benchmarking protocol ensuring fair comparisons through model-tailored hyperparameter optimization for EEG-FMs and supervised baselines; (2) three paradigm-level ablation workflows isolating contributions of heterogeneous data scale, self-supervised pretraining, and pretrained linguistic priors; and (3) a neurophysiological probing (NPP) framework exploring whether FMs leverage valid EEG features. translated_title: EEG-FM-Audit：脑电图基础模型的系统性评估与分析流水线
translated_abstract: 脑电图基础模型（EEG-FMs）展现出从异构脑电信号中学习通用表征的潜力。然而，现有研究存在三个关键局限：模型调优过程不透明、复杂学习范式对EEG-FMs的贡献未经实证验证，以及对基础模型赖以做出决策的神经生理学特征理解有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了EEG-FM-Audit，一个包含三个模块的系统性评估与诊断流水线：（1）公平校准的基准测试协议，通过对EEG-FMs和有监督基线模型进行量身定制的超参数优化来确保公平比较；（2）三个范式级别的消融工作流，用于分离异构数据规模、自监督预训练和预训练语言先验的贡献；（3）神经生理学探测（NPP）框架，用于探究基础模型是否利用了有效的脑电特征。
tldr: 提出了EEG-FM-Audit系统性评估与诊断流水线，通过公平校准基准测试、范式级别消融实验和神经生理学探测三大模块，全面审计脑电图基础模型的性能表现、各学习范式的真实贡献及其决策所依赖的神经生理学特征的有效性。
en_tdlr: We propose EEG-FM-Audit, a systematic evaluation and diagnostic pipeline for EEG foundation models that integrates fairness-calibrated benchmarking, paradigm-level ablation workflows, and neurophysiological probing to audit model performance, the true contributions of learning paradigms, and the validity of neurophysiological features underlying model decisions.
